The reporting is not: 7.8.1 rule 1 is that 'derived from nothing' and 'derived and found nothing' must never print the same, and this file adds a third state, 'derived and found something wrong', and prints it under the first one's header. nonBlocking.why: Residual V5 discloses the escape accurately and gates it with a case expected to escape - that is correct practice and I uphold it. What is overstated is the framing: the source says 'The property is MONOTONICITY' and names the gate decision-monotonicity, and 7.10's derived rule is to pin the property. A packet-only lane cannot observe monotonicity, which is a relation between two states over time; it can only observe whether today's packet contradicts itself. The author chose packet-only for a good reason - nothing written into the directory can demote a finding it makes, which I verified by source inspection: the four decision-lane predicates contain no open(), read_text, read_bytes, Path(), HERE, scan_artifacts or head_named_artifacts. The choice is right and the label claims more than the choice can deliver. Measured cost of the escape: 3 edits, versus the 1 the predecessor needed for its own escape.

isTheBLOCKER1DERIVATIONSOUND-orDoesItMer.verdict: SOUND about WHAT to test, ARBITRARY about HOW MUCH - and the file says so itself, in the one residual it leaves ungated.
reasoning: The two values it tests are supplied by the packet, not chosen by the author: decidedBy and decidedOn are read off $.decisions.CD-RT-5 and nothing else. The gate needs no vocabulary, no stop-list and no English. That is a genuine derivation and it is the difference between this and every stop-list repair that would have gone stale.

I tested the load each limb carries rather than accepting the four-limb story. Ablating AUTHORITY-AMBIENT moves survivors 5 -> 47; ablating AUTHORITY-SINGLE-SOURCE moves them 5 -> 23; running only UNATTRIBUTED+VACUOUS gives 65. No limb is decoration. AUTHORITY-VACUOUS fires on 13 of 328 and catches the corner the inherited role gate structurally cannot see ('every meaningful token is a role' is vacuously true when there are no meaningful tokens) - I confirmed decidedBy 'this and that' is caught by v4 and not by v3.

The arbitrariness that remains is the threshold: TWO witnesses. That number is argued by analogy to 4.4's 'Two files, one source', and the analogy cuts the other way - 4.4's finding was that two positions written in one authoring pass are NOT corroboration. Residual V7 concedes precisely this ('POSITIONALLY independent and not EVIDENTIALLY independent ... which is precisely the two files, one source shape section 4.4 rejects, one level down') and V7 is one of the 11 residuals that is NOT GATED. I measured the consequence: a fabricated authority needs 3 field edits, ALL INSIDE $.decisions.CD-RT-5 - decidedBy plus two attribution leaves - and no edit anywhere else in the packet. Case F7, a plausible human name; case F14, the 3-character nonsense string 'aaa'; both EXIT 0.

So the honest statement of the repair's strength is: it raised the cost of a fabricated attribution from ONE field edit to THREE, all in the same object the forger is already editing, and it removed 307 of the 312 candidate authorities that named nobody. The first half is modest. The second half is the real gain, and it is large.
isTheBLOCKER1DERIVATIONSOUND-orDoesItMer.residualV1sTEXTIsSLIGHTLYWIDERTHANTHEMEA: V1 reads 'install at least TWO leaves that each name the substituted identity together with the decision date, and leave no occurrence of it anywhere else in the packet', which reads as a packet-wide obligation. Measured, all three edits fit inside the decision row and nothing outside it must change; the 'no occurrence anywhere else' clause is satisfied for free by any identity the packet does not already use. Not wrong, but it reads harder than it is.

closingNote: Three things this review found that it did not expect to. First, the author's own hypothesis test was the best thing in the file: they measured the derivation they were asked for, found it excluded none of the five escapes it was proposed to close, published that, and shipped a different one. I recomputed it - 37 of 328 excluded, 0 of 5 escapes - and it holds. Second, my own sharpest hypothesis was wrong: I expected the AMBIENT limb to be an unpaid-for false-positive generator and ablation showed it carries two of the five named escapes alone. Reported over the expectation. Third, and this is the one that matters: the instrument's central sentence is PRESENCE IS NOT ATTRIBUTION. It is right, it is derived, and it was aimed at one field of one row. Section 4.4's fabrication was never in that field - it was in a register and a rejected candidate, two files, one source. Running that same sentence one level out is the last repair this lineage owes, and the corpus supplied the regression corpus for it two generations ago: five mutations sitting unexecuted in check-product-dispositions.py, all five of which a decided packet now accepts.
